designs.design_A:
Image 1 is the STYLE reference only: copy its drawing style exactly, but draw a DIFFERENT man (different hair, face and clothes).

Art style: soft modern anime illustration, thin coloured lineart, soft cel shading with one soft-edged shadow layer, romantic otome-game card quality (like a top-tier otome game's love-interest card), clean and calm, not glossy. Realistic adult proportions (7.5 heads, not chibi). He is EXTREMELY handsome: an idol-level beautiful face, a sharp clear jawline, a straight nose, long lashes, smooth fair skin, slim and tall with broad shoulders — the kind of man the whole chat falls for.

Gaku, 26, a solo winter-camping live streamer: cool, quiet and a little aloof at first glance (kuudere), actually gentle and clumsy with words; a rare, small, shy smile.

Look A: layered black hair, medium-short, soft bangs falling just over the eyebrows, narrow phoenix eyes with dark-grey irises, one small black stud earring in his right ear. A chunky off-white cable-knit turtleneck sweater under an open deep forest-green mountain parka. Sitting on a low camp chair by the fire, an enamel mug in both hands, glancing at the viewer with a cool, quiet look and the faintest smile. Upper body, centred.

Background: a winter lakeside campsite at night — a crackling campfire in a ring of stones casting warm amber light on him from the RIGHT side, a canvas tent glowing faintly behind, dark pine trees, a frozen blue lake, light snow on the ground and a starry navy-blue sky; cold blue moonlight from the LEFT. Warm amber vs cold blue, soft round bokeh of the fire sparks.

Wide 16:9 illustration. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI.

Avoid: chibi, super-deformed, realistic photo, 3D render, extra fingers, deformed hands, readable text, glossy airbrush, heavy bloom, beard, stubble, scars, rugged or old-looking face, silver / pink / red / platinum hair, glasses, sunglasses.
